llm.summary: This skill is a Chinese K12 classroom-interaction coaching aid with disclosed, purpose-aligned use of classroom planning records and teacher-confirmed observation logs.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly designed for Mainland China Chinese K12 classrooms, including simplified Chinese examples and China-specific education/safety assumptions; this is coherent but should be localized before use elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package is markdown and JSON guidance only; I found no executable scripts, remote payload loading, package installation, or tool-wrapping behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation examples are broad teacher requests, but they stay within classroom-interaction scenarios and the skill explicitly routes lesson planning, exam design, and analytics requests to other skills.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill uses platform memory/workspace capability and writes only interactionLogs, with privacy controls, teacher confirmation before persistence, no student-name field in logs, and guidance to avoid recording individual classroom impressions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is classroom interaction coaching for teachers, and its capabilities fit that purpose: it reads lesson plans, student tiers, class profile, and weakness summaries, then helps design questioning, group activities, cold-call alternatives, and post-class observations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a teacher-facing classroom interaction coach for Mainland China Chinese K12 contexts. Before using it elsewhere, localize curriculum assumptions, safety referral contacts, and data-consent rules; also review the classroom-record controls because it can read class workspace data and create teacher-confirmed interaction log entries.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad classroom-trigger examples are real, but they are ordinary teacher classroom-interaction requests and align with the skill's disclosed purpose; I did not find evidence of hidden activation, unrelated data access, or automatic writes.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese language and Mainland China defaults are documented in shared/platform-conventions.md and crisis guidance as the intended deployment scope, so the locale issue is a user-fit/localization consideration rather than suspicious behavior.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The supplied static scan reported no results, and artifact inspection did not reveal instruction hijacking, persistence backdoors, remote execution, or credential handling.
